guides.title: Before you flash anything
steps: Charge the phone to at least 60%.
Back up photos, chats and app data to your PC or cloud.
Note your exact model (DN2101 or DN2103) under Settings → About phone.
Download only files made for your model.
Install the latest ADB / fastboot platform-tools on your PC.

guides.title: Revert from an AOSP custom ROM to stock
steps: Note your device model in Settings → About phone.
Download the stock ROM for your model from the Firmware section (EU DN2103 or IN DN2101).
Install platform-tools on your PC and open a terminal in that folder.
On the phone, reboot to the AOSP recovery and choose Apply Update → Using ADB.
On the PC run: adb devices
Then run: adb sideload oplus_ota_downgrade.zip
If your custom ROM was based on DN2103 (EU) firmware, flash the EU stock ROM first.
When flashing is done, format data and reboot to system.
Check that everything works: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio and so on.
Only if you want to lock the bootloader and you are fully back on stock: reboot to the bootloader and run fastboot flashing lock.

guides.title: Switch from DN2103 to DN2101 firmware (India users, optional)
steps: You need an unlocked bootloader and a full data backup, because this erases everything.
In Settings, turn off network access for the Software Update app so it can't push OTA updates meanwhile.
Enable Developer options by tapping the version number 5 to 6 times.
Open Software Update, tap the three dots and choose Local install.
Select the OxygenOS 11.3 IN ROM, install it and reboot.

guides.title: Restore BROM / fastboot (make the phone brick-proof)
steps: Credit: @NishantKumar6342 discovered this BROM bypass.
You need a fully charged phone, OxygenOS F.50 or lower (tested) with USB debugging on, and the bulletproof_denniz zip from the Tools section.
Extract the zip and open a terminal inside the folder.
Run: adb reboot fastboot
Run: fastboot flash sda preloader_ufs_c01.img
Run: fastboot flash sdb preloader_ufs_c01.img
Run: fastboot flash lk lk_a20.bin
Run: fastboot flash lk2 lk2_a20.bin
Run: fastboot reboot

guides.title: Debloat with Shizuku and Canta (no root)
steps: Install Shizuku and Canta Debloater from the Tools section.
Enable Wireless debugging in Developer options.
Pair Shizuku with your device using the official Shizuku setup guide.
Give Canta access in Shizuku.
Open Canta, select the apps you want to remove and tap Uninstall.
Warning: only remove apps marked Recommended. Removing core system packages can crash your system.
